event.description: Share one free FF output vector across blocks
event.proposal: family: parameter tying; current retained incumbent is 2830 parameters at 99.9800%, a +0.98 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0062, sharing the already tied FF hidden-unit vector across blocks at 2830/99.98%; same-family failed result: attempt-0063, sharing one free FF input vector across blocks at 2816/0.49%. Prior attempts in this family: 9. Hypothesis: the failed one-sided input tie may be specific to depth-varying feature extraction, so share only one free hidden unit output column across blocks while retaining independent input projections and all other outputs. This saves 14 parameters for a target of 2816. This is more informative than repeating the input tie or tying both sides because it is the complementary one-sided test and isolates whether output mixing is more redundant than input feature detection; the nearest alternative is a larger full-projection tie already shown to fail. Keep d14/h2/L2, MQA, independent head-local maps, ff23 with one within-block tied unit and one cross-block shared free output, two final LayerNorm group scales, rank8 positions, affine-free block pre-norms, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2830 parameters.
